newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos wins Botany gas supply deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos wins Botany gas supply deal.

text.p: Cooper Basin natural gas producer Santos Ltd said on Monday it had reached an agreement with the Australian Gas Light Co (AGL) and ALISE Energy Australia Pty Ltd (ALISE) for the supply of gas to a proposed cogeneration power plant at Botany in Sydney.

Santos said the proposed plant would generate electricity from natural gas from South Australia's Cooper Basin, which had been selected by ALISE as the most competitive source of energy in the new deregulated market.
A Santos spokesman said the contract would be worth more than A$1 billion to the Cooper Basin producers over 20 years.
He said ALISE Energy Australia was a consortium consisting of Air Liquide, Energy Australia (the former Sydney Electricity), and Itochu Corp of Japan.
The contract was subject to conditions including the need for other South Australian Cooper Basin Producers to agree to similarly sell their portion of the gas supply, Santos said.

"It is anticipated that this project could increase the demand for natural gas in New South Wales by up to 25 percent. It will use in excess of 20 petajoules of natural gas per annum," Santos said in a statement.

Santos said until September 2006 the gas required by the project would be supplied from the existing gas supply contract between the South Australian Cooper Basin Producers and New South Wales gas distributor, AGL.
The major purchaser of electricity will be public utility, Energy Australia, which was also one of the major shareholders in ALISE, Santos said.
The Botany cogeneration plant to be constructed by the ALISE consortium will use the natural gas to produce up to 350 megawatts of electricity and 300 tonnes per hour of steam.
Santos said the Botany plant was expected to be commissioned in 1999 and the gas supply committment was for a period of 20 years from this time.
Other Cooper Basin producers include Exxon Corp's Delhi Petroleum unit, Boral Ltd and Crusader Ltd.
